# KinImmortal

Cleanse a terrible curse from Dracula’s blood, restoring it's ability to maintain form outside the Shadow Realm.

---

Thanks to the V Rising modding and server communities for ideas and requests!

This was a collaborative effort from Odjit (DJ) and zfolmt ([Mitch](https://www.patreon.com/join/4865914)); feel free to reach out in the modding discord for questions or help with the mod!
